title: n8n Business Automation
description: Business automation with n8n covering workflow design, nodes, triggers, webhooks, HTTP requests, expressions, database workflows, and AI automation.
learning_outcomes: Design and build automation workflows in n8n
Use various nodes for data processing and transformation
Create triggers from webhooks, schedules, and events
Integrate with APIs, databases, and email services
Implement conditional logic and looping in workflows
Build business process automation for CRM, marketing, and operations
